limitations: All 19 physical author pages were re-read independently before opening A’s inventory. Söllner physical3 chart and Fleischmann physical4/6 graphs and text were visually inspected. Primary candidate source tables/pages were rendered and inspected.
Every one of 66 frozen claims, including supported and unresolved non-findings, was reviewed. B’s raw inventory was not edited. No author contact or human specialist confirmation.

Primary sources archived by A were reopened independently, and separate publisher/author sources and recalculations were used where needed. Failed peer Mattsson download is not evidence; the valid archived original A paper was read instead.

Conservative scope: F21 aggregate-feedback inference and F33 implicit measurement/model wording remain challenged. This does not endorse the author’s climate conclusions. F30 is the universal country-range claim, separate from Germany’s approximately-six urban ratio.
F34 concerns frequency-matched support for the hearing/perception threshold. It does not establish a precise universal 1 Hz threshold or harmlessness below it.
Söllner’s 8 October author date, 5 October committee cover and 7 October hearing remain separate. No delivery chronology is inferred.
